root_cause.text: The ncm_unwrap_ntb() function lacks a lower bound check on block_len, allowing unsigned integer underflow in subsequent bounds checks (ndp_index > (block_len - opts->ndp_size) and datagram index checks) when block_len is smaller than opts->ndp_size, which nullifies the validation and enables out-of-bounds reads via skb_put_data().
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "When block_len is smaller than opts->ndp_size, the bounds check of ndp_index > (block_len - opts->ndp_size) will underflow producing a huge unsigned value that ndp_index can never exceed, defeating the check entirely." The patch adds the lower bound check: `if ((block_len < opts->nth_size + opts->ndp_size) || (block_len > ntb_max))`.
